TRANSPORTATION SYSTEMS CENTER KENDALL SQUARE CAMBRIDGE, MASSACHUSETTS 02142
In reply refer
to: TSC-83
August 17, 1977
Mr. Marvin Siflinger Acting Area Office Director Department of Housing and Urban Development 15 New Chardon Street Boston, MA 02114
Att: Environmental Clearance Officer
Re: Draft Environmental Impact Statement Kendall Square, Urban Renewal Project Cambridge, MA 02142
Dear Mr. Siflinger,
In response to your letter of June 21, 1977 the Draft Environmental Impact Statement (DEIS) for the Kendall Square project has been reviewed. The DEIS is considered a comprehensive assessment of the current conditions and also the probable environmental impact, which will be generated by the project.
This office accepts the findings of the DEIS as presented.
Sincerely,
Director of Administration
